caption: Amager Strandpark, Copenhagen
composition: Lagoon, footbridge, and the island beach · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the city-side promenade, a low footbridge crosses the lagoon to the sandy island, with dunes and the Øresund beyond. The night is overcast, about 13.3°C, with no rain, and the beach is empty. Promenade lamps light the sand. This is the 2005 island-and-lagoon park, not the older Helgoland sea bath.
